summary: Iteration 2 follow-up test of 4 NEW features only. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases green (POST /api/auth/google returns 401 on invalid session; login/signup/me regression still pass; GET /api/progress/trends returns 8 buckets with non-null int dev_score <=99, fg_pct int|null; GET /api/dashboard includes trained_today bool; fresh signed-up user gets trained_today=false). Frontend: /auth shows data-testid='google-login'; /report renders trend-chart with recharts SVG and 4 line paths, labels include FG% and DEV; /coach handsfree-toggle + handsfree-switch toggles unchecked->checked; sending a message with hands-free ON fires POST /api/tts (1 request captured); manual coach-tts-btn still present on assistant messages; on Dashboard smoke user had trained_today=false so streak-nudge banner rendered with nudge-train and nudge-dismiss, and clicking nudge-dismiss hid the banner correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_google uses sync `requests.get` inside an async endpoint; wrap in asyncio.to_thread or use httpx.AsyncClient to avoid blocking the event loop.
auth_google inserts the user with `password_hash: None`; ensure /api/auth/login rejects empty/None password_hash rather than allowing empty-string bypass (verify verify_password handles None safely).
progress_trends pulls up to 10k shots + 5k workouts into memory each request; add a $gte week-window filter or Mongo aggregation before scale.

Dashboard nudge dismiss state is stored in localStorage per-day key `nudge-<date>` - fine, but the banner will re-appear after midnight even if user has already dismissed and then trains; low priority.
TrendChart 8-bucket loop calls `_parse_dt` for every shot in every iteration (O(8*N)); pre-bucket shots once by iterating N to save CPU on larger histories.
test_credentials: smoke@test.com / test1234 (already onboarded, streak=1, trained_today may flip depending on daily workouts).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 fresh TEST_ users (one for signup regression, one onboarded with zero workouts to verify trained_today=false). No production data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features working end-to-end. Note: coach-preset buttons only render when messages.length==0; smoke user already has chat history so tests must fall back to coach-input + coach-send (both flows verified). AI reply + TTS auto-trigger latency ~10-25s; use 40s timeouts. Real Google OAuth flow not automated - only backend 401 error path validated as instructed.
